spans.text: Lumites are a feral scavenger race of insectoid monsters who prowl spawn in large hives, using space wreckage to move from planet to planet. Where they originated in the universe isn’t well known, nor is the method by which they seem to turn up everywhere—however, they do seem to exist across the galaxy and are a threat that any meteor may bring with it. Though considered an exolunar threat, they can be found on many planets as a terrestrial threat.

Exolunar creatures are able to survive in the vacuum of space. They have the instincts required to tell direction based on stars and other celestial bodies, and do not require air to breathe in a void. They can survive far longer than terrestrial creatures, requiring a day’s worth of food or water only every two weeks while in a vacuum.
